title: TestAGateThatOutlivesItsReconcilerKeepsHoldingItsSlot is load-flaky under the suite's own -parallel 12
body: In one full internal/reconcile run on a loaded host the test failed with 'the slot was still held 5s after the gate died' (gatedir_orphan_unix_test.go:80); it passes in 0.52s in isolation and the suite was green on the next full run. It is a wall-clock test measuring the host, the known learning shape that stopped eight innocent runs; a tick could bound its wait on the observable (the slot's release) rather than a fixed 5s.
